name: @heybotos/desktop
description: HeyBotOS for macOS: the native window, menu-bar item and shortcuts around the local HeyBotOS service.
author: HeyBotOS contributors

scripts.install-app: node scripts/make-app.mjs && mkdir -p "$HOME/Applications" && rm -rf "$HOME/Applications/HeyBotOS.app" && /usr/bin/ditto "dist/$(uname -m | sed s/x86_64/x64/)/HeyBotOS.app" "$HOME/Applications/HeyBotOS.app" && echo "Installed in ~/Applications/HeyBotOS.app"
